thread.title: Wall Street Bullish on Netflix Ahead of Earnings

author: Jon Swartz
title: Wall Street Bullish on Netflix Ahead of Earnings
text:
Netflix ( NFLX ) has been on a tear this year. Its shares have gained 15% in 2018, including a 2.5% gain today, buoyed in part by continued speculation that the company could become a takeover target for Apple ( AAPL ).
Illustration: Bloomberg News Wall Street analysts expect Netflix to report revenue of $3.28 billion when it announces its fiscal fourth-quarter results later today. The company in October predicted an additional 6.3 million streaming subscribers worldwide during the quarter. (In the third quarter, Netflix added 5.3 million subscribers as it racked up $3 billion in revenue.)
Goldman Sachs analysts anticipate Netflix's domestic and international revenue and profits to "significantly" top estimates through content spending and increases in subscription fees. Analysts at Raymond James, meanwhile, maintain their "outperform" recommendation for Netflix shares, raising their target price from $220 to $260.
Wall Street will be closely watching what impact, if any, Netflix's increase in subscription services -- it raised the cost of standard plans $1 per month, to $10.99 -- has on subscription growth. And it has a watchful eye on how Walt Disney's ( DIS ) planned acquisition of 21st Century Fox ( FOXA ) assets could create more competition for Netflix in the streaming market.
RBC Capital Markets sees "no significant reaction "to (the) pending price increase" in Netflix's quarterly report.
